verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a keyboard-driven outliner with typed shortcuts (`[[]]`, `(())`, `/query`), community praise for keyboard list manipulation, and an embedded PDF reader. Nothing in the pack documents headings, callouts, tables or code blocks. Speed is contradicted by hands-on reports of lag and of the editor dying when pasting a few paragraphs, though one DB-nightly user calls it very fast. Missing for 10: documented headings, callouts, tables and code-block formatting; embedding of general media in notes; consistent editor performance.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can write and format notes with headings, callouts, tables, code blocks, and embedded media in a fast keyboard-driven editor

citations.quote: You can type `/query` to create a simple query.
Type `[[]]` to create or reference any other page.
list manipulation with many keyboard/mouse shortcuts feels better than in Obsidian
the embedded PDF reader is quite good
